description: Answer a worker's completion-deadline extension request on one of your bounties, or proactively extend a worker's deadline. Only meaningful when the bounty sets completionWindowHours. 'approve' grants the worker's requested hours, 'deny' declines (the original deadline resumes and the overdue seat will auto-release), 'grant' extends by `hours` with or without an open request. Pending requests appear on applications from get_bounty_applications as completionExtension with status 'requested'; an open request pauses the auto-release for up to 24 hours. Owner only.

action.description: 'approve' grants the worker's open extension request, 'deny' declines it (the original deadline resumes), 'grant' extends by `hours` whether or not a request is open.

applicationId.description: The accepted application whose completion deadline to decide

hours.description: Extension length in hours. Required for 'grant'; for 'approve' it is only the fallback when the request did not name an hour count.
hours.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(720)

name: decide_extension_request
